_comment: The five background clips, generated with Higgsfield (seedance_2_5, 1080p, 5s, silent).
build_site.py prefers a local media/hero-N.mp4 and falls back to `url` when there isn't one.
To inline them: download each url to media/raw/hero-N.mp4, run tools/encode_media.py --all,
then tools/build_site.py. That produces a genuinely self-contained page.
This sandbox cannot reach the CDN host (egress allowlist), so the current build references
the urls directly and leans on the CSS atmosphere beds wherever they cannot load.

clips.prompt: Polished chrome and smoked-glass cubes on matte charcoal, rising and settling into an ascending staircase curve. Indigo rim light, warm bone fill, slow dolly-in.
Dense field of thin vertical glass rods of varying heights on bone, refracting lavender caustics. Slow lateral parallax.
Translucent frosted-glass sheets stacked like strata, each carrying a carved ridge line, sliding into alignment. Ink-blue, indigo edge light, dust motes.
Polished steel sphere travelling through a lattice of brushed-metal rails in near darkness, trailing warm light. Motion blur, fast tracking.
Taut dark fabric membrane deforming into deep wells under invisible weights, contour ridges rippling. Raking terracotta light, slow drift.
